title: Sunrise log record (v1)
description: NDJSON record shape per docs/10-cross-cutting/logging.md §3. One record per newline. Produced by tracing-subscriber's JSON formatter with flatten_event(true), so context fields sit at the top level alongside the envelope. Validated against live output by crates/sunrise-log/tests/record_schema.rs.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 with millisecond precision in UTC (sunrise_log::Rfc3339Millis).

level.description: tracing::Level, uppercase. The five levels of logging.md §2.

message.description: Human-readable summary. MUST NOT interpolate plaintext user data.

target.description: tracing target: the emitting module path. Replaces the old pkg + mod pair.

ev.description: Hierarchical event name; must be catalogued in docs/10-cross-cutting/log-events.md.

span.description: Innermost active span: its `name` plus its fields. Present only inside a span; the ancestor list is not emitted (with_span_list(false)).

err_code.description: Stable canonical error code from docs/10-cross-cutting/error-handling.md. Set on warn/error.

cause.description: Bottom-most source() message after redaction. MUST NOT contain plaintext user data.

propertyNames.description: Additional top-level keys are context fields and MUST come from the allowlist in crates/sunrise-log/src/field.rs, which sunrise_log::RedactionLayer enforces at emit time.
